cat > /tmp/s5.sh <<'SCRIPT_EOF'
> /tmp/cands.txt
P1='PASS'; P2='WORD'; lit="$P1=$P2"
for off in 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
  tail -c +$((off+1)) /tmp/d.dat | tr '\000' '\001' | fold -w 48 > /tmp/fd_$off.txt
  grep -anF "$lit" /tmp/fd_$off.txt > /tmp/hits_$off.txt || true
  while IFS=: read -r n ln; do
    pre=${ln%%"$lit"*}; st=$(( ${#pre} + 9 )); rem=$(( 48 - st ))
    if [ "$rem" -ge 23 ]; then
      pw=$(printf '%s' "$ln" | cut -c $((st+1))-$((st+23)))
    else
      nx=$(sed -n "$((n+1))p" /tmp/fd_$off.txt)
      pw=$(printf '%s' "$ln" | cut -c $((st+1))-48)$(printf '%s' "$nx" | cut -c 1-$((23-rem)))
    fi
    printf '%s\n' "$pw"
    abs=$(( off + (n-1)*48 + ${#pre} ))
    echo "HIT off=$off line=$n abs=$abs" >> /tmp/hitinfo.txt
    dd if=/tmp/d.dat bs=1 skip=$((abs-12)) count=60 2>/dev/null >> /tmp/ctx_$off.bin
    echo '----' >> /tmp/ctx_$off.bin
  done < /tmp/hits_$off.txt >> /tmp/cands.txt
done
echo DONE-ALL
sort -u /tmp/cands.txt | while read -r c; do echo "CAND len=${#c}: $c"; done
SCRIPT_EOF
bash /tmp/s5.sh
